episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.summary: Doting dad Trevor Bingley arrives at a couple's lavish home to house-sit while they're away. A bee follows closely behind — and the battle begins.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.summary: Trevor tries to remember the codes to unlock the library and prevent further damage. Later, he must reschedule upcoming plans with his daughter.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.summary: A police officer checks in on things. Cupcake ruins her prescription dog diet with peanut butter. Trevor releases the bee outside — but not for long.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.summary: With Cupcake's help, Trevor finds a messy way back inside and deals major damage with a kitchen hand mixer before the police officer arrives again.

episodes.title: Chapter 5
episodes.summary: Trevor cleans up with a shower under flashy lights and a groovy soundtrack. Later, the bee leads Trevor to the couple's grand piano.

episodes.title: Chapter 6
episodes.summary: Trevor tries to repair more damaged art. After chatting with Maddy, Trevor becomes too preoccupied with the bee to notice art burglars have broken in.

episodes.title: Chapter 7
episodes.summary: The burglars reveal themselves at an opportune time. Trevor must take Cupcake to the vet after his bee trap doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Chapter 8
episodes.summary: Trevor gets behind the wheel of Christian's expensive car to head to the vet. Later, a desperate Trevor devises a way to get rid of the bee for good.

episodes.title: Chapter 9
episodes.summary: With Nina and Christian on their way back home, Trevor goes in pursuit of his unrelenting rival with blazing fury.
